home.howSubtitle: A simple four-step process to resolve civic issues

01.title: Report
01.desc: Submit your civic complaint with details and location

02.title: AI Analysis
02.desc: Our AI system analyzes and categorizes the issue automatically

03.title: Department Action
03.desc: Complaint is routed to the relevant civic department

04.title: Resolution
04.desc: Issue is resolved and you receive status updates

home.ctaTitle: Have a civic issue to report?
home.ctaDesc: Help us make your city better. Report issues, track progress, and contribute to smarter governance.

services.waterDesc: Report water supply issues, leakage, contamination, or service disruption
services.roadsDesc: Report potholes, damaged roads, traffic signal issues, or transport problems
services.electricityDesc: Report power outages, faulty streetlights, or electrical hazards
services.wasteDesc: Report garbage collection issues, illegal dumping, or sanitation problems
services.healthcareDesc: Report public health concerns, hospital issues, or medical emergencies
services.environmentDesc: Report pollution, deforestation, noise issues, or environmental hazards
services.trafficDesc: Report traffic congestion, signal malfunctions, or road safety issues
services.publicSafetyDesc: Report safety hazards, broken infrastructure, or security concerns
services.otherDesc: Report any other civic issue not covered above
services.pageSubtitle: Browse available civic service categories and report issues
services.cantFindDesc: You can select "Other Civic Issues" or contact our support team for assistance.

report.pageSubtitle: Help us identify and resolve civic issues in your area
report.step3Desc: Upload photos or use your camera to capture the issue. Photos help departments understand and verify the problem faster.
report.step4Desc: Please review all the details before submitting.
report.descPlaceholder: Describe the issue in detail — what, where, since when, how it affects the area
report.optionalMedia: Attaching photos is not mandatory but greatly helps in faster issue resolution.
report.aiNote: Once submitted, our AI system will automatically analyze and categorize your complaint for faster routing and resolution.
report.successDesc: Your complaint has been registered with GovMind AI.
